Requested ember-cli commands:

ember generate <blueprint> <options...>
  Generates new code from blueprints.
  aliases: g
  --dry-run (Boolean) (Default: false)
    aliases: -d
  --verbose (Boolean) (Default: false)
    aliases: -v
  --pod (Boolean) (Default: false)
    aliases: -p, -pods
  --classic (Boolean) (Default: false)
    aliases: -c
  --in-repo-addon (String) (Default: null)
    aliases: --in-repo <value>, -ir <value>
  --lint-fix (Boolean) (Default: true)
  --in (String) (Default: null) Runs a blueprint against an in repo addon. A path is expected, relative to the root of the project.
  --typescript (Boolean) Generates a version of the blueprint written in TypeScript (if available).
    aliases: -ts
  --dummy (Boolean) (Default: false)
    aliases: -dum, -id


  Available blueprints:
    fixtures:
      basic <name>
        A basic blueprint
      basic-esm <name>
        A basic blueprint
      basic_2 <name>
        Another basic blueprint
      exporting-object <name>
        A blueprint that exports an object
      with-templating <name>
        A blueprint with templating
    ember-cli:
      addon <name>
        The default blueprint for ember-cli addons.
      addon-import <name>
        Generates an import wrapper.
      app <name>
        The default blueprint for ember-cli projects.
      blueprint <name>
        Generates a blueprint and definition.
      http-mock <endpoint-path>
        [Classic Only] Generates a mock api endpoint in /api prefix.
      http-proxy <local-path> <remote-url>
        [Classic Only] Generates a relative proxy to another server.
      in-repo-addon <name>
        The blueprint for addon in repo ember-cli addons.
      lib <name>
        Generates a lib directory for in-repo addons.
      server <name>
        [Classic Only] Generates a server directory for mocks and proxies.
